anomalies.description: A sudden plume of dark smoke erupts from the central facade of the building near the clock tower between frames 1 and 2 (around 10–11s), expanding rapidly in subsequent frames. The smoke origin is localized and abrupt, consistent with an explosion or detonation event—no visible fire or debris trajectory due to resolution, but the instantaneous appearance and growth of a dense smoke cloud matches the expected anomaly pattern for an explosion.
